title: Kibelisks (packs/<game>/<faction>/kibelisks.json)
description: The Kibelisk registry (0.5 P8, docs/design/0.4-smart-next-up.md §3): one record per Kibelisk. Every `kibelisk` name a record uses (giver / turn-in / entrance / location, objective fields and '(Kibelisk: X)' markers) resolves to exactly one record by name (AION 2 pack check). The id is kib:<slug of the name at creation> and is frozen: a rename changes `name`, never `id` (a bind:<id> save key never moves).

id.description: kib:<slug>, frozen when the record is created (never derived from the name at runtime).

name.description: The in-game name, exactly as the records cite it.

map.description: The map it is on (the coords map id); null when no source places it.

zone.description: Our zone (zones.json) it belongs to; null when no source places it or the sources disagree (then `conflicts` says how). zones[].kibelisks lists exactly the records filed in that zone (pack check).
